name: Imatinib
pdbDescription: Abl kinaza domeni Imatinib (STI-571) bilan kompleksda

formExplanation.title: Imatinib mezilat (Mesylate) nima beradi?
formExplanation.uz: Mezilat — metansulfonat (CH3SO3⁻). Imatinib mezilat bu tuzdir: protonlangan [imatinib+H]⁺ kationi manfiy zaryadlangan CH3SO3⁻ anioni bilan birga keladi. Imatinib molekulasining o'zida oltingugurt (S) YO'Q — u faqat qo'shilgan mezilat qarshi-ionida mavjud.
formExplanation.en: Mesylate means methanesulfonate (CH3SO3⁻). Imatinib mesylate is a salt form: a protonated [imatinib+H]⁺ cation paired with the negatively charged mesylate counterion. There is NO sulfur in the imatinib parent drug itself.

memoryCue.uz: Imatinib = Azotli halqalar juftligi + amid ko'prigi + piperazin dumi
memoryCue.en: Imatinib = nitrogen-ring pair + amide bridge + piperazine tail

landmarks.uz: Ikki xil 6 a'zoli aromatik azotli halqa. Piridinda 1 ta azot (N), pirimidinda 2 ta azot (N) bor. Ular o'zaro bog'langan (kondensirlanmagan).
landmarks.en: Two connected six-membered aromatic rings with nitrogen: pyridine (1 N) and pyrimidine (2 Ns).

landmarks.uz: C(=O)–NH guruhi. Karbonil (C=O) bevosita azot bilan bog'langan bo'lib, amidni hosil qiladi.
landmarks.en: One amide link C(=O)–NH between benzene rings.

landmarks.uz: Aromatik bo'lmagan 6 a'zoli halqa bo'lib, qarama-qarshi tomonlarida 2 ta azot atomi bor. Bir azotida metil (-CH3) guruhi, ikkinchisi metilen (-CH2-) orqali benzol halqasiga ulangan.
landmarks.en: Non-aromatic six-membered ring with two opposite nitrogens, methylated at the tail.

landmarks.uz: Skeletida faqat ugleroddan iborat aromatik benzol halqalari. Galogenlar (F, Cl) mavjud emas.
landmarks.en: Two purely carbon benzene rings. Contains zero halogens.

mechanism.uz: BCR-ABL onkogen oqsilining nofaol (DFG-out) konformatsiyasidagi ATP bog'lanish cho'ntagiga kirib, kinaza fosforillash faolligini to'xtatadi va leykemiya hujayralari ko'payishini bloklaydi.
mechanism.en: Binds to the inactive (DFG-out) ATP-binding pocket of BCR-ABL kinase, preventing ATP hydrolysis and blocking downstream oncogenic signaling.

name: Nilotinib
pdbDescription: Abl kinaza domeni Nilotinib (AMN107) bilan kompleksda

formExplanation.title: Tasigna va Nilotinib gidroxlorid monogidrati
formExplanation.uz: Tasigna preparati nilotinib monogidroxlorid monogidrati (nilotinib·HCl·H2O) ko'rinishida chiqariladi. Kristall panjaradagi suv va xlorid kislota molekulalari asosiy neytral nilotinib skeletiga kovalent bog'lanmagan.
formExplanation.en: Tasigna contains nilotinib monohydrochloride monohydrate. Crystal water and HCl counterion are not part of the neutral covalent drug skeleton.

memoryCue.uz: Nilotinib = Tanish N-halqalar juftligi + imidazol + 3 ta F (Triftormetil)
memoryCue.en: Nilotinib = familiar N-ring pair + imidazole + three fluorines (CF3)

landmarks.uz: Imatinibdagi kabi tanish 6 a'zoli piridin-pirimidin tizimi saqlanib qolgan.
landmarks.en: Preserves the same 6-membered pyridine-pyrimidine landmark as imatinib.

landmarks.uz: Imatinibda pirimidin tomondagi benzol amid azotiga ulangan bo'lsa, nilotinibda karbonil uglerodiga (C=O) ulangan. Yo'nalish teskari!
landmarks.en: Inverted amide orientation: the pyrimidine-side benzene connects to the carbonyl carbon.

landmarks.uz: Nilotinibda PIPERAZIN HALQASI UMUMAN YO'Q! Buning o'rniga 5 a'zoli 2 ta azotli aromatik imidazol halqasi kiritilgan.
landmarks.en: Completely lacks piperazine! Instead has a 5-membered aromatic imidazole ring.

landmarks.uz: Bitta uglerod atomiga 3 ta ftor (F) kovalent bog'langan. Ushbu F atomlari tuz emas, molekulaning ajralmas qismidir.
landmarks.en: One carbon carries three fluorine atoms (-CF3), covalently attached to the benzene ring.

mechanism.uz: Imatinibga chidamli ko'plab BCR-ABL mutatsiyalariga qarshi 20-50 baravar yuqori yaqinlik (affinity) bilan bog'lanib, DFG-out konformatsiyasini qulflaydi.
mechanism.en: Engineered with 20- to 50-fold higher binding potency than imatinib against unmutated and many imatinib-resistant BCR-ABL kinase variants.

name: Dasatinib
pdbDescription: Abl kinaza domeni Dasatinib (BMS-354825) bilan kompleksda

formExplanation.title: Sprycel va Dasatinib monogidrati
formExplanation.uz: Dasatinib amaliyotda monogidrat shaklida uchraydi. ChEBI da suvsiz (anhydrous) va monogidrat shakllari alohida ajratilgan. Kristall panjarasidagi suv yangi OH tarmog'i emas.
formExplanation.en: Encountered clinically as a monohydrate. The anhydrous parent and hydrated form are distinct in ChEBI.

memoryCue.uz: Dasatinib = S-tiazol halqasi + 1 ta Cl + OH bilan tugovchi yon zanjir
memoryCue.en: Dasatinib = S-ring (thiazole) + one Cl + an OH-ended side chain

landmarks.uz: 5 a'zoli aromatik tiazol halqasida 1 ta oltingugurt (S) va 1 ta azot (N) bor. Bu S bevosita preparat molekulasining tarkibiga kiradi!
landmarks.en: Five-membered aromatic thiazole ring containing one sulfur and one nitrogen directly inside the drug parent.

landmarks.uz: Tiazol va benzol halqasi o'rtasida C(=O)–NH amid guruhi joylashgan.
landmarks.en: Amide C(=O)–NH linkage connecting the thiazole region to the chlorinated benzene.

landmarks.uz: Piperazin halqasining oxirida –CH2–CH2–OH (spirt) guruhi bor. Bu spirt guruhidagi kislorod ikkinchi kislorod atomidir.
landmarks.en: Piperazine ring terminating in a hydroxyethyl tail (–CH2–CH2–OH alcohol).

landmarks.uz: Benzol halqasiga 1 ta xlor (Cl) atomi va 1 ta metil guruhi kovalent birikkan. Cl bu yerda xlorid tuzi emas, molekula a'zosi.
landmarks.en: Benzene ring with one covalent chlorine (Cl) and one methyl substituent.

mechanism.uz: Ko'p nishonli (multi-targeted) dual BCR-ABL va SRC oilasi kinaza ingibitori. Imatinibdan 325 baravar kuchliroq bo'lib, oqsilning faol (DFG-in) hamda nofaol konformatsiyasini bog'lay oladi.
mechanism.en: Dual BCR-ABL and SRC family kinase inhibitor with 325-fold higher potency than imatinib; binds both active (DFG-in) and inactive conformations.

name: Bosutinib
pdbDescription: Abl kinaza domeni Bosutinib (SKI-606) bilan kompleksda

formExplanation.title: Bosulif va Bosutinib monogidrati
formExplanation.uz: Bosulif preparati bosutinib monogidrati shaklida tayyorlanadi. Suv kristallografik assotsiatsiyada bo'lib, xinolin skeletiga kovalent qo'shilmagan.
formExplanation.en: Manufactured as bosutinib monohydrate; crystal water is non-covalently associated.

memoryCue.uz: Bosutinib = Kondensirlangan xinolin yadrosi + nitril (-C≡N) + 2 ta Cl
memoryCue.en: Bosutinib = fused quinoline core + nitrile (-C#N) + two chlorines

landmarks.uz: Ikkita 6 a'zoli halqa bir chekka (ikkita atom va ular orasidagi bog') orqali kondensirlangan (birlashgan). Benzol va piridin birlashib xinolinni hosil qiladi.
landmarks.en: Fused bicyclic quinoline core sharing two ring atoms and the bond between them.

landmarks.uz: Yadrodan chiquvchi uch bog'li –C≡N guruhi. Nitril azoti halqa ichida emas, tashqarida joylashgan.
landmarks.en: A nitrile group –C#N with triple bond extending from the quinoline core.

landmarks.uz: Piperazin dumi yadroga –O–CH2–CH2–CH2– (uchta uglerodli efir) ko'prigi orqali bog'langan.
landmarks.en: Piperazine connects to quinoline through a 3-carbon propoxy ether spacer (–O–(CH2)3–).

landmarks.badge: 2 ta Xlor va Metoksi guruhlari (AMID YO'Q!)
landmarks.uz: Boshqa 3 preparatdan farqli o'laroq, BOSUTINIBDA AMID GURUHI UMUMAN YO'Q! Uning o'rniga oddiy amin bog'i (-NH-) va 2 ta metoksi efiri (-OCH3) mavjud.
landmarks.en: CRITICAL DIFFERENCE: Has NO amide group! Connected via secondary amine and ethers, with two aromatic chlorines.

mechanism.uz: Dual SRC/ABL kinaza ingibitori. Ko'pchilik imatinibga chidamli BCR-ABL mutatsiyalarini ingibirlaydi (T315I mutatsiyasidan tashqari) va minimal KIT/PDGFR ingibitsiyasi tufayli boshqacha nojo'ya ta'sir profiliga ega.
mechanism.en: Dual SRC/ABL inhibitor targeting most imatinib-resistant BCR-ABL mutations (except gatekeeper T315I), with reduced cross-inhibition of KIT and PDGFR.

name: Ponatinib
pdbDescription: Abl T315I mutanti Ponatinib (AP24534) bilan kompleksda

formExplanation.title: 3-avlod vositasi va T315I darvozabon mutatsiyasi
formExplanation.uz: Boshqa 1 va 2-avlod ingibitorlari T315I darvozabon (gatekeeper) mutatsiyasida steric to'siqqa duch keladi. Ponatinibdagi uglerod-uglerod uch bog'li (alkin) ko'prik mutatsiyaga uchragan I315 yon zanjirini chetlab o'tish imkonini beradi.
formExplanation.en: Engineered with a rigid carbon-carbon triple bond (alkyne bridge) specifically designed to bypass the steric clash of the bulky T315I gatekeeper mutation.

memoryCue.uz: Ponatinib = Alkin (-C≡C-) uch bog' ko'prigi + Imidazopiridazin + CF3
memoryCue.en: Ponatinib = alkyne triple-bond bridge + imidazopyridazine + CF3

landmarks.uz: Birlashgan geterotsiklik tizim, kinaza bog'lanish cho'ntagining chuqur qismiga kiradi.
landmarks.en: Fused heteroaromatic system occupying the adenine region.

landmarks.uz: Chiziqli qattiq uglerod uch bog'i. Aynan shu bog' T315I mutatsiyasini steric to'siqsiz chetlab o'tadi.
landmarks.en: Linear rigid alkyne linker bypassing the isoleucine 315 side chain.

landmarks.uz: Benzol halqasida joylashgan -CF3 guruhi va amid bog'i.
landmarks.en: Trifluoromethyl group and amide bridge.

landmarks.uz: Eruvchanlikni ta'minlovchi metilpiperazin halqasi.
landmarks.en: Solubilizing methylpiperazine tail.

mechanism.uz: 3-avlod pan-BCR-ABL ingibitori. Barcha bittalik mutatsiyalarga, jumladan o'ta chidamli T315I mutatsiyasiga qarshi juda yuqori faollikka ega.
mechanism.en: Potent 3rd-generation pan-BCR-ABL inhibitor active against all single resistance mutations, crucially overcoming T315I.

name: Asciminib
pdbDescription: Abl kinaza domeni Asciminib (ABL001) allosterik cho'ntagida

formExplanation.title: STAMP (Specifically Targeting the ABL Myristoyl Pocket) mexanizmi
formExplanation.uz: ATP cho'ntagiga emas, balki kinazaning miristoil (allosterik) cho'ntagiga bog'lanadi. Bu butunlay yangi sinf bo'lib, ATP cho'ntagidagi barcha mutatsiyalarda ham ta'sirini saqlaydi.
formExplanation.en: First-in-class STAMP inhibitor binding allosterically to the myristoyl pocket rather than the ATP-binding site.

memoryCue.uz: Asciminib = Allosterik miristoil cho'ntagi ingibitori (STAMP) + Diftorometoksi + Xlor
memoryCue.en: Asciminib = Allosteric myristoyl pocket binder (STAMP) + Difluoromethoxy + Cl

landmarks.uz: Oqsilning o'z-o'zini ingibirlash mexanizmini tiklovchi allosterik qism.
landmarks.en: Engages the myristoyl pocket to restore autoinhibition.

landmarks.uz: Kislorod va 2 ta ftor atomiga ega yon zanjir.
landmarks.en: Difluoromethoxy moiety.

landmarks.uz: Xlor atomi o'rin olgan benzol halqasi.
landmarks.en: Chlorinated phenyl group.

landmarks.uz: 3 a'zoli uglerod halqasi (siklopropan) bilan bog'langan amid guruhi.
landmarks.en: Cyclopropylcarboxamide terminal motif.

mechanism.uz: STAMP (Specifically Targeting the ABL Myristoyl Pocket) mexanizmi orqali BCR-ABL kinazasining tabiiy miristoil bog'lanish joyiga kirib, oqsilni nofaol shaklga keltiruvchi allosterik ingibitor.
mechanism.en: Specifically targets the ABL myristoyl pocket (STAMP), restoring endogenous autoinhibition through allosteric conformational locking.
